description: Class representing a pivot table data field.

AutoSort.description: Establishes automatic field-sorting rules for the pivot table reports.

params.description: The sort order.
params.name: order

params.description: The name of the field to sort by (pivotField.SourceName, pivotField.Name, dataField.Name).
params.name: field

ClearAllFilters.description: Deletes all filters currently applied to the pivot field.

ClearLabelFilters.description: Deletes all label filters or all date filters from the pivot filters collection.

ClearManualFilters.description: Deletes all manual filters from the pivot filters collection.

ClearValueFilters.description: Deletes all value filters from the pivot filters collection.

GetCaption.description: Returns a value that represents the label text for the data field.

GetCurrentPage.description: Returns the current page which is displayed for the page field (valid only for page fields).

GetDragToColumn.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the column position.

GetDragToData.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the data position.

GetDragToPage.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the page position.

GetDragToRow.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the row position.

GetFunction.description: Returns a function performed in the data field.

returns.description: func - The function performed in the added data field.

GetIndex.description: Returns an index of the data field.

GetLayoutBlankLine.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether to insert blank rows after each item.

GetLayoutCompactRow.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether a pivot table field is compacted.

GetLayoutForm.description: Returns the way the specified pivot table items appear — in table format or in outline format.

GetLayoutPageBreak.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether to insert a page break after each field.

GetLayoutSubtotals.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether to show subtotals.

GetName.description: Returns a value representing the object name.

GetNumberFormat.description: Returns a value that represents the format code for the object.

GetOrientation.description: Returns a data field orientation value that represents the data field location in the specified pivot table report.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent object for the current field.

GetPivotField.description: Returns the pivot field from which the data field was created.

GetPivotFilters.description: Returns the collection of pivot filters applied to the specified pivot field.

GetPivotItems.description:
Returns an object that represents either a single pivot table item (the ApiPivotItem object)
or a collection of all the visible and hidden items (an array of the ApiPivotItem objects) in the specified field.

params.description: The item index.
params.name: index

GetPosition.description: Returns a value that represents the data field position within a category.

GetRepeatLabels.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether to repeat items labels at each row.

GetShowAllItems.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether to show items with no data.

GetShowingInAxis.description: Returns the setting which specifies whether the pivot table field is currently visible in the pivot table.

GetSourceName.description: Returns a source name for the pivot table field.

GetSubtotalName.description: Returns the text label displayed in the subtotal column or row heading in the specified pivot table report.

GetSubtotals.description: Returns an object that represents all subtotals.

GetTable.description: Returns the ApiPivotTable object which represents the pivot table for the current field.

GetValue.description: Returns a value representing the name of the specified data field in the pivot table report.

Group.description:
Groups the dates of the pivot table field by periods or its numbers by intervals, as VBA Range.Group does for a cell of the field.
The field must be in the rows or columns; grouping again replaces the previous grouping of the field.
For dates, the field shows the shortest period, and a new field is added next to it for every longer one.

params.description: The first value to group, or true for the first value of the field. A date is a Date object or its serial number.
params.name: start

params.description: The last value to group, or true for the last value of the field.
params.name: end

params.description: The size of each group of numbers, or the number of days in each group when the dates are grouped by days alone. If omitted, the size of the number groups is chosen automatically and each day is a group.
params.name: by

params.description: Seven values which specify whether the dates are grouped by seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, quarters and years. If omitted, the dates are grouped by months. The numbers ignore it.
params.name: periods

returns.description: Returns true if the field is grouped, or false if it is not in the rows or columns, has values that are neither dates nor numbers, the pivot table has no source records, the grouped report would cover other cells, or other users are editing the document.

Group.signature: Group(start?: boolean | number | Date, end?: boolean | number | Date, by?: number, periods?: boolean[]): boolean

Move.description: Moves the current pivot field inside the category.

params.description: The direction to move the pivot table field,or the pivot field orientation type.
params.name: type

params.description: The field index in a new category.
params.name: index

Move.signature: Move(type: PivotMoveFieldType | PivotFieldOrientationType, index?: number): void

Remove.description: Removes the current pivot field from the pivot table.
